scenes.narration: The final chapter: placement rapid fire. These are the analog questions asked again and again in interviews and written tests. Try to answer each one before the answer appears.
scenes.title: PLACEMENT RAPID-FIRE
scenes.subtitle: The most asked analog questions

scenes.narration: Rapid fire: diodes. What is the barrier potential of Si and Ge? 0.7 V and 0.3 V. Why does a diode block in reverse bias? Majority carriers are pulled away, the depletion region widens. What is the PIV of a centre-tap rectifier? 2 Vm. Ripple frequency of a full-wave rectifier on 50 Hz? 100 Hz. Why is a Zener reverse biased? It regulates in breakdown.
scenes.title: RAPID-FIRE · DIODES
lines: What is the barrier potential of Si and Ge? 0.7 V and 0.3 V.
Why does a diode block in reverse bias? Majority carriers are pulled away, the depletion region widens.
What is the PIV of a centre-tap rectifier? 2 Vm.
Ripple frequency of a full-wave rectifier on 50 Hz? 100 Hz.
Why is a Zener reverse biased? It regulates in breakdown.

scenes.narration: Rapid fire: clippers & clampers. A clipper changes the shape; a clamper keeps the shape and shifts the DC level. In a shunt clipper, why a series resistor? To limit current when the diode conducts. Clamper condition? RL·C much greater than the signal period. Positive clamper output for ±10 V input? −0.7 V to +19.3 V.
scenes.title: RAPID-FIRE · CLIPPERS & CLAMPERS
lines: A clipper changes the shape; a clamper keeps the shape and shifts the DC level.
In a shunt clipper, why a series resistor? To limit current when the diode conducts.
Clamper condition? RL·C much greater than the signal period.
Positive clamper output for ±10 V input? −0.7 V to +19.3 V.

scenes.narration: Rapid fire: bjt. IB = 20 µA, β = 150: IC = 3 mA. α = 0.98: β = 49. Most stable bias? Voltage divider. Which configuration has the highest input impedance? CC (emitter follower). Which configuration inverts? CE, 180°. Transistor as a switch uses which regions? Cutoff and saturation. What causes thermal runaway? Rising temperature → more leakage → more current → more heat.
scenes.title: RAPID-FIRE · BJT
lines: IB = 20 µA, β = 150: IC = 3 mA.
Most stable bias? Voltage divider.
Which configuration has the highest input impedance? CC (emitter follower).
Which configuration inverts? CE, 180°.
Transistor as a switch uses which regions? Cutoff and saturation.
What causes thermal runaway? Rising temperature → more leakage → more current → more heat.

scenes.narration: Rapid fire: fet & op-amps. Why is a MOSFET's input impedance so high? Insulated (oxide) gate. CMOS idle power? Almost zero: one transistor is always off. Golden rules of op-amps? V+ = V− and no input current, with negative feedback. Inverting gain with Rf = 100k, Rin = 10k? −10. What is slew rate? Maximum rate of output change, V/µs. Comparator vs Schmitt trigger? Schmitt has hysteresis from positive feedback.
scenes.title: RAPID-FIRE · FET & OP-AMPS
lines: Why is a MOSFET's input impedance so high? Insulated (oxide) gate.
CMOS idle power? Almost zero: one transistor is always off.
Golden rules of op-amps? V+ = V− and no input current, with negative feedback.
Inverting gain with Rf = 100k, Rin = 10k? −10.
What is slew rate? Maximum rate of output change, V/µs.
Comparator vs Schmitt trigger? Schmitt has hysteresis from positive feedback.

scenes.narration: Rapid fire: everything else. Capacitor blocks DC, passes AC; inductor passes DC, blocks high frequency. Cutoff of RC filter? 1/(2πRC), output 70.7%. Barkhausen criterion? Loop gain 1, phase 360°. Class B efficiency? 78.5% max; Class A 25%. 555 astable frequency? 1.44/((R1+2R2)C).
scenes.title: RAPID-FIRE · EVERYTHING ELSE

scenes.narration: And that's the complete analog electronics course. We started with a single electron and finished designing real circuits: resistors, capacitors, inductors, A C, filters, semiconductors, diodes, rectifiers, clippers, clampers, regulators, B J Ts, F E Ts, feedback, oscillators, power amplifiers, op amps and the five five five. If this helped you, share it with a friend who's preparing for exams or placements, and subscribe for more. All the best.
